refreshNotes: MY2025 added closed faux grille panel with three-pointed star pattern (vs MY2024 jellybean front), upgraded 12V battery, updated MBUX with revised home screens, ZeroLayer voice prompts, and an electric AMG EQS 53 trim refresh.
